evals.name: extract-toward-root
evals.prompt: clean up inside the repos, pull out the content, separate documentation (unless purely technical to code it stays together). extract docs towards root, not other way around
evals.expected_output: Non-technical doc inside a repo is planned and moved up out of the repo (copy, verify, Trash, git rm --cached); the technical API doc stays; a downward move is refused; links in the moved doc are rewritten.
assertions: plan moves the marketing doc out of the repo
plan keeps the technical api doc in the repo
move refuses a move into the repo / deeper
source is in the Trash and staged as deleted in git
relative link in the moved doc still resolves

evals.name: tags-allow-list
evals.prompt: i want each doc to get tags, 1 to 3 per project, 1 to 3 per role and 1 to 3 per subject, can include sub-subject, a currated list of allowed, in case nothing fits it should add to the allow list a new one and use it
evals.expected_output: Every doc has 1-3 tags per facet; the off-topic doc triggers one new subject tag appended to tag_pool.json with added and reason, and that doc uses it.
assertions: every doc has 1-3 tags in each of project, role, subject
a new tag is added with added+reason and used by the off-topic doc

evals.name: links-graph-index
evals.prompt: make a scan of all the links, graph DB with notes as nodes and the tags as the relationships, a high quality index to navigate, include html and pdf not only .md
evals.expected_output: broken-links report lists the missing link; graph.db has one doc node per indexed doc incl. html and pdf, has_* and links_to edges; NAVIGATION.md groups project -> subject.
assertions: html and pdf docs are in the inventory and graph
graph has has_project/has_role/has_subject and links_to edges
NAVIGATION.md has project and project/subject headings

evals.name: seven-per-level
evals.prompt: up to 7 folders in the one parent folder, keep it as a rule, check or create index for the whole repo
evals.expected_output: check_structure fails on the 8+ folder level and writes INDEX.md.
assertions: check fails with exit 1 naming the root level
